issue.positionEn: A garage, a lacquer object, a knitted sample and an old recording each preserve choices made in their making. This edition begins with those details.
issue.introEn: Brussels turns a Citroën garage into a museum. Shenzhen puts historical and contemporary lacquer on the same floor. A Kanazawa craft fair runs through hotel rooms, while a Ginza exhibition brings out 180 knitted colour samples. Two music stories make the methods audible, from a 1969 live recording to Peter Gabriel’s two mixes of the same song.
issue.closingEn: Walk an exhibition by its rooms or by a material. On a record, try two versions of the same song and listen for what moves closer.
